map.CNPJ 两位校验位按 mod-11：权重循环 2..9，Σ(权重 × 数字): CNPJ's two check digits use mod-11: weights cycle 2..9, Σ(weight × digit) mod 11; if remainder < 2 use 0, else 11 − remainder

map.CNPJ 的校验位怎么算？: How are CNPJ check digits computed?
map.前 12 位按权重 [5,4,3,2,9,8,7,6,5,4,3,2] 加权求和: First 12 digits weighted by [5,4,3,2,9,8,7,6,5,4,3,2], summed mod 11; remainder <2 → 0 else 11−remainder gives digit 13; then recompute digit 14 using the 13 digits.
map.CNPJ 是 14 位企业税号，CPF 是 11 位个人税号，两者算法相似但位数: CNPJ is the 14-digit corporate tax number, CPF the 11-digit personal tax number; similar algorithms but different length and weights.
map.校验通过代表公司真实注册吗？: Does passing validation mean the company is really registered?
map.不代表。格式通过不等于在巴西税务局有效登记，须官方渠道核验。: No. Format passing does not equal valid registration at the Brazilian tax authority; verify through official channels.
